title: Rudzi Rwakapikisa Imba Tsvene
intro: Munguva dzekare, rudzi rune simba rwakasarudza kurwisa nzvimbo tsvene yairemekedzwa nevatendi. Boka iri raive rakapfuma, rine simba, uye rine chivimbo musimba ravo rehondo. Vakauya nechisikwa chikuru chaizoshanda sechombo chavo chehondo. Chinangwa chavo chaive chakajeka: kuputsa imba tsvene nekupwanya kutenda kwevanhu vayo. Asi kuzvikudza kwavo kwaive kuda kusangana nemhinduro inoparadza kubva kumusoro. Chiitiko ichi chenhoroondo chakava chiratidzo nechidzidzo kune vese vakazotevera. Unogona here kuziva boka iri kubva pazviratidzo?
clues: Taiva rudzi rwakakomborerwa nepfuma uye hunyanzvi hwehondo.
Takaunganidza mauto edu tikaunza chikara chikuru kuti tishandise muhondo yedu.
Chinangwa chedu chaive nzvimbo tsvene yataida kuparadza zvachose.
Taitenda kuti simba redu raizokwana kukunda dziviriro ipi zvayo yaMwari.
Asi Jehovha akatitumira chirango kubva kudenga chataisatarisira.
